FINAL IVX PRODUCTION COMPLETION — FIX THE REAL 7 REMAINING ITEMS

OWNER DIRECTIVE

The previous 100% completion block must be replaced.

The latest audit confirms that the backend, API, landing page, Supabase registration, owner authentication, and core IVX IA infrastructure are substantially working.

However, IVX is not yet fully production-complete for real users.

Do not repeat old 16/16 PASS claims.

Complete these seven remaining items one by one, in this exact order.

==================================================
1. SECURE THE EXPOSED OWNER STATUS ROUTE
==================================================

Audit:

GET /api/ivx/owner-ai/status

Current reported issue:

The route may return owner/internal status without authentication.

Required fix:

- Require a valid owner JWT for internal details.
- Unauthenticated request must return HTTP 401 or 403.
- Non-owner request must return HTTP 403.
- Valid owner request must return HTTP 200.
- Do not expose credentials, environment values, internal file paths, deployment controls, or private worker details.
- If a public health status is required, create a separate minimal public-safe endpoint.

Add tests:

- no token
- expired token
- invalid token
- authenticated non-owner
- authenticated owner
- secret leakage scan

Return:

- route file
- middleware
- test results
- commit SHA
- live HTTP results

BLOCK 1 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until PASS.

==================================================
2. REMOVE AUDIT LOGS AND GENERATED STATE FROM GIT
==================================================

Current reported problem:

Many commits contain audit logs, JSON dumps, agent-state files, and generated execution records.

Audit the repository for:

- audit logs
- worker run logs
- agent-state JSON
- generated evidence files
- temporary reports
- screenshots
- build output
- caches
- local database files
- secret-bearing history files

Required actions:

- Move runtime logs to Supabase, storage, Render logs, or an IVX-controlled logging service.
- Add generated folders and files to .gitignore.
- Keep only required test fixtures.
- Remove generated files from Git tracking without deleting production data.
- Do not rewrite published history unless necessary and owner-approved.
- Confirm no credentials remain in Git history or current files.

Return:

- files removed from tracking
- .gitignore changes
- secret scan result
- repository size before/after
- commit SHA

BLOCK 2 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until PASS.

==================================================
3. VERIFY CI ON THE EXACT LATEST COMMIT
==================================================

Repository:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Branch:

main

Required:

- Confirm the latest GitHub HEAD.
- Run CI on that exact SHA.
- Do not use results from an older deployed SHA.
- Do not accept local tests as CI proof.

Required CI jobs:

- TypeScript
- lint
- backend tests
- Expo tests
- integration tests
- owner-auth tests
- chat tests
- member-registration tests
- reels tests
- security scan
- secret scan
- dependency audit
- zero-Rork audit
- Android release validation
- iOS configuration validation
- deployment gate

If any job fails:

- identify root cause
- fix
- commit
- push
- rerun until green

Return:

- GitHub HEAD SHA
- workflow name
- CI run ID
- all job results
- final conclusion

BLOCK 3 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until PASS.

==================================================
4. REDEPLOY RENDER FOR EXACT SHA PARITY
==================================================

Current reported mismatch:

GitHub HEAD and production SHA are different.

Even if only logs differ, final production certification requires exact parity.

Required equality:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA
=
Render API SHA
=
Render worker SHA
=
Chat frontend SHA
=
/version SHA

Required actions:

- Deploy the exact CI-green GitHub HEAD.
- Restart API and worker on the same SHA.
- Deploy chat frontend from the same approved source.
- Verify /health.
- Verify /version.
- Verify boot time.
- Verify no stale instance is serving the older SHA.

Return:

- GitHub SHA
- CI SHA
- API deployment ID and SHA
- worker deployment ID and SHA
- frontend deployment ID and SHA
- /version SHA
- SHA parity result

BLOCK 4 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until PASS.

==================================================
5. BUILD AND PUBLISH THE ANDROID APP
==================================================

The Expo source code existing is not sufficient.

Create a real production Android release.

Required configuration:

- correct application ID
- production API URL
- production Supabase project
- production chat URL
- release signing
- version name
- version code
- no development menu
- no localhost
- no temporary tunnel
- no Rork runtime dependency
- no exposed secrets

Create:

- installable APK for direct testing
- AAB for Play Store readiness

Publish the APK at an IVX-controlled download URL.

Return:

- EAS build ID
- application ID
- version
- build number
- APK filename
- APK URL
- APK checksum
- AAB status
- signing status
- build timestamp

BLOCK 5 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until the APK is installed successfully.

==================================================
6. RUN REAL ANDROID DEVICE QA
==================================================

Install the final APK on a real Android phone.

Do not mark PASS because screen files exist.

Test the actual user flow:

1. Clean install
2. First launch
3. Owner login
4. Invalid login rejection
5. Logout and login again
6. Session persistence
7. Member registration from app
8. Member registration from landing
9. Same account login in app

13. Reels playback
14. Reels long-session stability
15. Image upload
16. Video upload
17. PDF upload
18. Members module
19. Investors

21. Deals
22. Wallet
23. Notifications
24. Settings

26. Network loss/recovery
27. App restart
28. Crash recovery

Measure:

- cold start
- warm start
- first useful content
- first message response
- realtime latency
- crash count
- duplicate messages
- out-of-order messages

Return:

- device model
- Android version
- app version/build
- timestamps
- screenshots
- logs
- PASS/FAIL for every test

BLOCK 6 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until the critical user flow passes.

==================================================
7. FINALIZE THE PUBLIC CHAT POLICY
==================================================

Current reported behavior:

Public chat uses fallback AI while owner chat uses the real AI provider.

This must be intentional, not accidental.

Choose one:

OPTION A — LIMITED PUBLIC ASSISTANT

- safe general answers
- clear sign-in message for advanced IVX IA
- no owner data
- no developer tools
- no deployment access
- rate limits
- cost controls
- no false claim that the public chat is the full owner AI

OPTION B — REAL PUBLIC AI

- approved AI provider
- public-only system prompt
- no private data
- no internal tools
- rate limits
- cost limits
- moderation
- timeout and fallback
- abuse protection

Verify separately:

- public chat
- member chat
- owner chat

Return:

- selected policy
- provider/model
- route
- capabilities
- restrictions
- rate limits
- live test result

BLOCK 7 STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================

==================================================
